summary: Residents who opposed a mandatory filter distinguish their objection from opposition to a family's choice.
realLife: Mainstream Loudoun's representatives told a federal commission they supported voluntary filters and reported that the trustees adopted a choice-based policy in December 1998.
inGame: needs: old policy and recorded replacement vote.

turns.what: A resident explains why the revised offer meets part of the objection.
turns.writesBack: The board hears which feature changed the resident's view.

turns.pulledBy: The proposed rule would again cover every patron.
turns.what: The resident returns to the earlier objection.
turns.writesBack: Trustees must address the difference at the next vote.
